{"command": "create", "path": "/memories/session/plan.md", "file_text": "# Plan: serve create-pantoken-app skill at create.pantoken.app

## Goal
Stand up `create.pantoken.app` as a URL-hack shortcut that serves the `create-pantoken-app`
skill's raw content directly at the domain root (no `/create-pantoken-app.md` path needed),
via a new minimal GitHub repo (added to this repo as a submodule) deployed to GitHub Pages with
a custom domain, plus a new Cloudflare DNS record. Update all existing in-repo references to the
old `pantoken.app/create-pantoken-app.md` URL to the new canonical `https://create.pantoken.app`.

## Decisions (from user Q&A)
- Hosting: new GitHub repo → GitHub Pages, custom domain `create.pantoken.app` (not a Cloudflare
  Worker or Pages rewrite).
- Submodule: added to this repo, holds the tiny static site source (synced from
  `ai/pantoken-ai/skills/create-pantoken-app/SKILL.md`).
- Existing references (getting-started.md, GetStartedTabs.vue, api-catalog, AGENTS.md): replace
  with the new `create.pantoken.app` URL.
- Cloudflare: no API access assumed — document the exact DNS record for manual entry.
- GitHub org/user for repo: `thedannywahl` (from `origin` remote), new repo suggested name
  `create-pantoken-app` (confirm exact name/visibility with user before creating).

## Key existing pattern to mirror
`docs/scripts/stage-create-pantoken-app-skill.ts` already copies
`ai/pantoken-ai/skills/create-pantoken-app/SKILL.md` → `docs/public/create-pantoken-app.md`,
wired into the VitePress build via a task in `docs/.vitepress/config.ts` (`watchPaths` /
`build` entry, ~line 180-185). Model the new sync script after this same task shape.

## Steps

### Phase A — New repo + submodule scaffold (blocks Phase B/C)
1. Create new GitHub repo `thedannywahl/create-pantoken-app` (public, MIT or same license as
   pantoken — confirm with user). Do not implement until user confirms exact repo name.
2. Add it as a git submodule in this repo, e.g. at `ai/create-pantoken-app-site/` (path TBD —
   propose under `ai/` alongside `ai/pantoken-ai` since it's a derivative artifact of that
   package). Use `git submodule add https://github.com/thedannywahl/create-pantoken-app.git
   ai/create-pantoken-app-site`.
3. Populate the submodule with:
   - `index.html` — plain-text copy of the skill content (no HTML markup; named `.html` only so
     GitHub Pages resolves it as the directory index at `/`).
   - `create-pantoken-app.md` — same content, `.md` extension, for parity with the existing
     `pantoken.app/create-pantoken-app.md` path (optional convenience alias, not root-index).
   - `.nojekyll` — disable Jekyll processing so files are served verbatim.
   - `CNAME` — containing `create.pantoken.app`.
   - Minimal `README.md` explaining this repo is generated from
     `ai/pantoken-ai/skills/create-pantoken-app/SKILL.md` in the `pantoken` repo and should not be
     hand-edited.
4. Enable GitHub Pages on the new repo (Settings → Pages → Source = branch `main` / root, or
   GitHub Actions — mirror whichever the user prefers; simplest is branch-based Pages since the
   repo has no build step).

### Phase B — Sync tooling in this repo (depends on Phase A path decision)
5. Add a new script, e.g. `docs/scripts/stage-create-pantoken-app-domain.ts` (sibling to the
   existing `stage-create-pantoken-app-skill.ts`), that copies
   `ai/pantoken-ai/skills/create-pantoken-app/SKILL.md` into the submodule's `index.html` and
   `create-pantoken-app.md`.
6. Wire it into `docs/.vitepress/config.ts`'s task graph the same way as the existing
   `@pantoken/docs#create-pantoken-app-skill` task (~line 180-185), or as a standalone `vp` task —
   TBD based on whether this should run on every docs build or only on demand (submodule commits
   need a manual `git add`/`commit`/`push` inside the submodule either way, since cross-repo CI
   push requires a PAT with write access to the new repo — flagged as a follow-up, not
   implemented now).
7. Document the manual sync + submodule update + push flow in a short section of
   `docs/conventions/build-and-docs.md` (or the new submodule's README) so maintainers know how
   to publish skill updates to `create.pantoken.app`.

### Phase C — Reference updates (independent of A/B, can happen anytime, but should land in the
same PR so docs stay consistent)
8. [docs/guide/getting-started.md](docs/guide/getting-started.md#L25) — change the `claude
   "Fetch https://pantoken.app/create-pantoken-app.md..."` example to
   `https://create.pantoken.app`.
9. [docs/.vitepress/theme/components/GetStartedTabs.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/GetStartedTabs.vue#L83)
   — update the `AGENT_PROMPT` constant's URL the same way.
10. [docs/public/.well-known/api-catalog](docs/public/.well-known/api-catalog) — update the
    `create-pantoken-app.md` `alternate` entry's `href` to `https://create.pantoken.app` (keep as
    a `text/markdown` typed link; decide whether to keep the old entry too for back-compat, or
    replace).
11. [ai/pantoken-ai/assets/AGENTS.md](ai/pantoken-ai/assets/AGENTS.md#L121-L126) — update the
    `/create-pantoken-app.md` bullet (~line 126) to reference `https://create.pantoken.app`
    instead of the `pantoken.app/` prefix used for the other bullets (this one is not a path off
    the main site anymore).
12. Check `ai/pantoken-ai/scripts/generate.ts` output and any `generated/` snapshots for the same
    string, regenerate via the package's generate step if it embeds this URL (Explore found no
    direct match, but re-check after edits since `generate.ts` may template from AGENTS.md).

### Phase D — DNS (manual, user-performed)
13. Document the exact Cloudflare DNS record to add (do not attempt via any API):
    - Type: `CNAME`
    - Name: `create`
    - Target: `thedannywahl.github.io`
    - Proxy status: DNS-only (grey cloud) — GitHub Pages custom domains require the record to be
      resolvable directly for GitHub's cert issuance/verification; proxied (orange-cloud) can
      break GitHub's domain verification and HTTPS provisioning.
    - TTL: Auto
14. After DNS propagates, set the custom domain in the new repo's Settings → Pages → Custom
    domain to `create.pantoken.app`, and enable "Enforce HTTPS" once GitHub finishes issuing the
    certificate (can take a few minutes to hours).

## Relevant files
- `docs/scripts/stage-create-pantoken-app-skill.ts` — existing sync script to mirror.
- `docs/.vitepress/config.ts` (~L180-185) — task graph entry to mirror/extend.
- `ai/pantoken-ai/skills/create-pantoken-app/SKILL.md` — canonical skill source, unchanged.
- `docs/guide/getting-started.md`, `docs/.vitepress/theme/components/GetStartedTabs.vue`,
  `docs/public/.well-known/api-catalog`, `ai/pantoken-ai/assets/AGENTS.md` — reference updates.
- New submodule path (TBD, proposed `ai/create-pantoken-app-site/`) — new static site source.
- `.gitmodules` — new entry for the submodule.

## Verification
1. `vp check` and `vp test` after edits (per repo review checklist).
2. `git submodule status` shows the new submodule initialized and pinned.
3. Manually `curl -sI https://create.pantoken.app/` (after DNS + Pages propagate) returns 200 and
   the body equals the skill file content.
4. Confirm `docs/public/.well-known/api-catalog` is still valid JSON and matches the linkset
   format used elsewhere (existing `service-doc`/`alternate` shape).
5. `pnpm changeset` for the user-visible URL change (per repo convention — every user-visible
   change needs a changeset committed).
6. Update `ASSURANCE.md`/`SECURITY.md` if this new repo/domain constitutes a new input surface
   worth noting (new public hosting surface, new DNS-controlled domain) — confirm with user
   whether this rises to that bar.

## Further Considerations
1. **New repo name/visibility** — confirmed as `create-pantoken-app` under `thedannywahl`, public?
   Need explicit user confirmation before creation (I cannot create GitHub repos directly from
   this environment — this step needs to be done manually or via `gh repo create` if the user
   wants me to run it).
2. **Cross-repo CI automation** — should skill updates auto-publish to the submodule repo via CI
   (needs a PAT secret with push rights to the new repo), or stay a manual maintainer step
   (`vp run` script + manual `git commit`/`push` in the submodule)? Recommend starting manual,
   revisit if skill updates become frequent.
3. **api-catalog dual entries** — keep old `pantoken.app/create-pantoken-app.md` linkset entry
   for back-compat alongside the new `create.pantoken.app` one, or fully replace? Recommend
   keeping both briefly during transition, then removing the old one in a follow-up once
   `create.pantoken.app` is verified working.
"}

## Plan: serve create-pantoken-app skill at create.pantoken.app

**TL;DR** — Create a new GitHub repo (`thedannywahl/create-pantoken-app`), add it as a submodule in this repo, populate it with a plain-text `index.html`/`create-pantoken-app.md` copy of the skill file plus `CNAME`/`.nojekyll`, deploy via GitHub Pages, add a Cloudflare `CNAME` DNS record for `create` → `thedannywahl.github.io`, and update all in-repo references from `pantoken.app/create-pantoken-app.md` to `https://create.pantoken.app`.

**Steps**

**Phase A — New repo + submodule**
1. Create `thedannywahl/create-pantoken-app` repo (confirm name/visibility before creating — I can't create GitHub repos from here).
2. Add as submodule, e.g. `ai/create-pantoken-app-site/`.
3. Populate: `index.html` (raw skill text, `.html` only so GitHub Pages resolves it as `/`), `create-pantoken-app.md` (parity alias), `.nojekyll`, `CNAME` (`create.pantoken.app`), README noting it's generated.
4. Enable GitHub Pages (branch-based, no build step needed).

**Phase B — Sync tooling** *(depends on A)*
5. New script `docs/scripts/stage-create-pantoken-app-domain.ts` mirroring the existing [stage-create-pantoken-app-skill.ts](docs/scripts/stage-create-pantoken-app-skill.ts), copying `SKILL.md` into the submodule.
6. Wire into `docs/.vitepress/config.ts`'s task graph (~L180-185) or a standalone `vp` task. Cross-repo push needs a PAT — flagged as follow-up, not done now (manual `git commit`/push in submodule for v1).
7. Document the sync/publish flow in `docs/conventions/build-and-docs.md`.

**Phase C — Reference updates** *(independent, same PR)*
8. [docs/guide/getting-started.md](docs/guide/getting-started.md#L25) — swap URL.
9. [docs/.vitepress/theme/components/GetStartedTabs.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/GetStartedTabs.vue#L83) — swap `AGENT_PROMPT` URL.
10. [docs/public/.well-known/api-catalog](docs/public/.well-known/api-catalog) — update `alternate` href.
11. [ai/pantoken-ai/assets/AGENTS.md](ai/pantoken-ai/assets/AGENTS.md#L126) — update bullet to new domain.
12. Re-check `ai/pantoken-ai/scripts/generate.ts` output for the same string post-edit.

**Phase D — DNS (manual)**
13. Cloudflare record: **Type** CNAME, **Name** `create`, **Target** `thedannywahl.github.io`, **Proxy** DNS-only (grey cloud — required for GitHub cert issuance), **TTL** Auto.
14. Set custom domain in new repo's Pages settings, enable "Enforce HTTPS" once cert issues.

**Relevant files**
- `docs/scripts/stage-create-pantoken-app-skill.ts` — pattern to mirror
- `docs/.vitepress/config.ts` — task graph entry
- `ai/pantoken-ai/skills/create-pantoken-app/SKILL.md` — canonical source (unchanged)
- `docs/guide/getting-started.md`, `docs/.vitepress/theme/components/GetStartedTabs.vue`, `docs/public/.well-known/api-catalog`, `ai/pantoken-ai/assets/AGENTS.md` — URL updates
- New submodule (proposed `ai/create-pantoken-app-site/`), `.gitmodules`

**Verification**
1. `vp check` / `vp test`
2. `git submodule status` shows new submodule pinned
3. `curl -sI https://create.pantoken.app/` → 200, body matches skill content (after DNS propagates)
4. `docs/public/.well-known/api-catalog` still valid JSON
5. `pnpm changeset` for the URL change
6. Confirm with user whether `ASSURANCE.md`/`SECURITY.md` need an update for this new public surface

**Decisions**
- Hosting: GitHub Pages + custom domain (not Cloudflare Worker/rewrite)
- Submodule holds the static site source, synced from the existing skill file
- All existing references get replaced, not duplicated long-term
- No Cloudflare API access assumed — DNS record documented for manual entry

**Further Considerations**
1. Confirm exact new repo name/visibility before I (or you) create it — I have no GitHub repo-creation access from this environment.
2. Cross-repo CI auto-publish (needs a PAT secret) vs. manual sync — recommend starting manual.
3. Keep the old `pantoken.app/create-pantoken-app.md` api-catalog entry temporarily for back-compat, or replace outright?

Let me know if you want changes, or if this looks good to hand off for implementation.
I created the repo thedannywahl/create-pantoken-app and it's currently checked out at ~/Scripts/create-pantoken-app
